results_section.claim: 1. before the reforms, low-income vehicles were about 17.9 percentage points less likely to be redeemed compared to higher-income proxies
results_section.explanation: Analysis stage: Notebook cell 4 (controls model) shows pre-computed output: treat_lowinc_proxy coef=-0.179539, which is -17.9 pp, exactly matching the claim. Notebook cell 6 (full model) shows treat_lowinc_proxy coef=-1.789372e-01=-0.178937, also approximately -17.9 pp. The coefficient represents the pre-policy baseline disparity between low-income and control groups.
